faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quickly find answers to your questions. If you can't find what you're looking for, feel free to contact us.
faq.notFoundQuestion: Didn't find the answer to your question?

questions.a: Harvests is a digital marketplace that connects African farmers with consumers, restaurateurs and other buyers. We make it easy to buy fresh produce directly from local producers.

questions.q: In which countries is Harvests available?
questions.a: Harvests is currently available in Senegal and is gradually expanding to other African countries. Check our website for updates on our expansion.
You can reach us by email at contact@harvests.site, by phone at +221 78 834 69 69, or through the contact page on our website.

questions.q: How do I create an account?
questions.a: Click 'Register' at the top of the page, choose your account type (consumer, producer, restaurateur, etc.), fill in the form and verify your email.
We offer several account types: Consumer (to buy), Producer (to sell agricultural products), Processor (to sell processed products), Restaurateur (to sell dishes), and Transporter (to deliver).

questions.q: I forgot my password, what should I do?
questions.a: Click 'Forgot password' on the login page, enter your email and follow the instructions sent to reset your password.

questions.q: How do I place an order?
questions.a: Browse the products, add them to your cart, then proceed to payment. You can choose your delivery method and track your order from your dashboard.
Delivery fees are calculated based on distance and weight. They are free for any order over 50,000 FCFA (depending on the partner's plan).
Delivery times vary depending on your location and the producer. In general, allow 1 to 3 days for urban areas. Exact times are shown when you place your order.
You can cancel your order as long as it has not been shipped. Go to 'My Orders' and click 'Cancel'. Once shipped, contact support.

questions.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
questions.a: We accept Mobile Money payments (Orange Money, Wave, Free Money), bank cards (Visa, Mastercard) and PayPal.
Yes, all payments are secure and encrypted. We use standard security protocols to protect your financial information.

questions.q: How do I get a refund?
questions.a: If there is a problem with your order, contact support within 48 hours. After verification, the refund will be issued within 5 to 10 business days.

questions.q: How do I become a partner on Harvests?
questions.a: Create a partner account (producer, processor or restaurateur), complete your profile with your information and required documents, then submit your validation request.

questions.q: What are the fees for partners?
questions.a: Harvests takes a commission on each sale. Rates vary depending on the account type and sales volume. See our pricing plans for more details.

questions.q: How do I manage my products?
questions.a: From your dashboard, you can add, edit or delete your products, manage your stock and track your orders.

terms.title: Terms of Use

sections.title: 1. Acceptance of the terms
sections.text: By accessing and using the Harvests platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Use. If you do not accept these terms, please do not use our platform.

sections.title: 2. Description of the service
sections.intro: Harvests is an online marketplace that connects:
items: Consumers looking for fresh, local products

sections.title: 3. Registration and user account
sections.intro: To use certain features of Harvests, you must create an account. You agree to:
items: Provide accurate and complete information when registering
Be responsible for all activity carried out under your account
Inform us immediately of any unauthorized use

sections.title: 4. Partner obligations
items: Offer products that match their descriptions and images
Comply with food hygiene and safety standards
Fulfill orders within the announced timeframes

sections.title: 5. Buyer obligations
items: Make payments within the allotted time
Receive orders at the agreed time slots
Report any problem within 48 hours of receipt

sections.title: 6. Payments and commissions
sections.text: Harvests takes a commission on each transaction made on the platform. Commission rates are communicated to partners when they register or through their subscription plan. Payments are secured and processed by our approved payment partners (Orange Money, Wave, PayPal, bank cards).

sections.title: 7. Cancellation and refunds
sections.text: Cancellation and refund conditions vary depending on the type of product and the timing of the cancellation. In general, an order can be cancelled free of charge as long as it has not been prepared or shipped. Refunds are processed within 5 to 10 business days.

sections.title: 8. Intellectual property
sections.text: All content on Harvests (logos, texts, images, software) is protected by intellectual property law. Any unauthorized reproduction or use is prohibited.

sections.title: 9. Limitation of liability
sections.text: Harvests acts as an intermediary between partners and buyers. We are not responsible for the quality of the products sold, for delivery delays attributable to partners or transporters, or for disputes between users.

sections.title: 10. Changes to the terms
sections.text: Harvests reserves the right to modify these terms at any time. Users will be informed of changes by email or notification on the platform. Continued use of the platform after a change constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy

sections.title: 1. Introduction
sections.text: At Harvests, we place great importance on protecting your personal data. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, store and protect your information when you use our platform.

sections.title: 2. Data collected
sections.intro: We collect the following types of data:

sections.title: 3. Use of data
items: Create and manage your user account
Ensure the delivery of your products
Send you notifications about your orders
Improve our services and your user experience
Send you marketing communications (with your consent)

sections.title: 4. Data sharing
sections.intro: We may share your data with:
sections.outro: We never sell your personal data to third parties.

sections.title: 5. International transfers
sections.text: Some of our technical providers (database hosting, image and document storage) process data outside Senegal. We require these providers to protect your data at a level consistent with our legal obligations. If you are located in another West or Central African country, the local law of your country of residence may also apply in addition.

sections.title: 6. Data security
sections.text: We implement technical and organizational security measures to protect your data: SSL/TLS encryption, secure storage, restricted data access, and regular security audits.

sections.title: 7. Data retention
sections.text: Your data is kept for as long as you use our services and for an additional period in accordance with legal obligations (generally 5 years for transaction data). You may request the deletion of your account and data at any time.

sections.title: 8. Cookies
sections.intro: A banner lets you choose, from your first visit, which cookies you accept:

leadItems.text: : required for the site to work (login, security, cart). Always active.
: to analyze how the site is used. Disabled until you accept them.

sections.outro: You can change your choice at any time via the "Manage cookies" link at the bottom of every page.

sections.title: 9. Your rights
sections.intro: In accordance with applicable regulations, you have the following rights:

leadItems.text: : obtain a copy of your data
: request the deletion of your data
: receive your data in a structured format
: object to the processing of your data
: withdraw your consent at any time

sections.title: 10. Changes
sections.text: We may update this privacy policy. Any change will be published on this page with a new update date. We encourage you to review this page regularly.

faq.question: How do I earn points?
faq.answer: You automatically earn points on every purchase. The number of points depends on your tier: Bronze and Silver (1 pt/100 XAF), Gold (1.5 pts/100 XAF), Platinum (2 pts/100 XAF).

faq.question: How do I use my points?
faq.answer: At checkout, you can choose to use your points. Each point is worth 1 XAF off your order. You decide how many points to use.

faq.question: Do points expire?
faq.answer: Points are valid for 12 months from the date they are earned. You will receive an email notification 30 days before they expire.

faq.question: How do I move up a tier?
faq.answer: Your tier is automatically updated based on your current points balance: Bronze (0-999), Silver (1000-4999), Gold (5000-9999), Platinum (10000+).

faq.question: Can I lose my tier?
faq.answer: Your tier depends on your current points balance. If you use a lot of points and your balance drops below the threshold, your tier may change.

faq.question: Is there a fee to join?
faq.answer: No, the loyalty program is completely free. You are automatically enrolled with your first order as a Bronze member.
